correctness.rationale: For d_mu(t)=(1+t/sqrt(t²+4mu))/2, scaling x=t/(2sqrt(mu)) reduces barrier shrink to g_sigma(x)=x[1/sqrt(x²+σ)−1/sqrt(x²+1)]/2. Its derivative has unique positive root x²=σ^(2/3)/(1+σ^(1/3)), producing D(σ)=(1−σ^(1/3))/(2sqrt(1+σ^(1/3)+σ^(2/3))) and the stated symmetric equality points. Since d_mu' is even and strictly unimodal, length-|h| intervals integrate maximally when centered at zero, giving H_mu(h)=|h|/sqrt(h²+16mu) with equality at t=−h/2. Differentiation in log(mu) yields max 1/(6sqrt(3)). Only inequality diagonal changes in J_mu(v), so its spectral norm difference is the max coefficient difference and is bounded by min(1,D+max H). The frozen-system residual follows from (J1−J0)J0^-1r and is sufficient, not necessary. Independent 27,030 point checks confirmed separate equality and bounds; proofs establish all real parameters. The joint sum is not claimed sharp.
